messages.text:
The wider probe set is mostly matching.

One error-path mismatch is just stderr newline translation; I’m changing error writes to bytes as well, so failures use the same `\n` line endings as the reference.

commands.commandLine:
"C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command "@'
import subprocess, pathlib, sys
root=pathlib.Path.cwd(); ref=pathlib.Path(root/'REFERENCE_BINARY.txt').read_text().strip(); port=[sys.executable,str(root/'xsv_port.py')]
td=root/'tmp_probe'
cmds=[['stats','--no-headers','freq.csv'],['frequency','--limit','0','--select','1','--no-headers','freq.csv'],['search','xxx','--no-headers','in.csv'],['sort','--no-headers','-R','in.csv'],['select','1,1','--no-headers','sel.csv']]
for args in cmds:
 rr=subprocess.run([ref]+args,cwd=td,capture_output=True); pp=subprocess.run(port+args,cwd=td,capture_output=True)
 ok=(rr.returncode,rr.stdout,rr.stderr)==(pp.returncode,pp.stdout,pp.stderr)
 print(args, 'OK' if ok else 'BAD')
 if not ok:
  print('ref',rr.returncode,rr.stdout,rr.stderr); print('port',pp.returncode,pp.stdout,pp.stderr)
'@ | python -"
